home.extensionsAnswer: Three free modules that add to Wanderer for World of Warcraft Forever. Wanderer Bags puts your bags and your bank in one window and keeps chosen items safe from any sale. Wanderer Auction brings the auction house into a Wanderer window and never sells below a merchant's price. Wanderer Quests shows every quest of your class, your dungeons and your zones, in chains. Each needs Wanderer and has its own page on wanderer-addon.com.

A click on a quest opens its sheet: what to do and its story, the items it asks with how many you carry, who gives it and who takes it back, a pin on your map for each.

faq.q: How do I find the quests that open a dungeon in WoW Forever?
faq.a: Install Wanderer Quests with Wanderer and open its Dungeons tab: each dungeon and raid lists its quests and every quest that leads to them, wherever they start, with where you stand with each and the entrance pinned on your map.

page.h1: The quests the world hides from you, in one quiet window
page.lead: Wanderer Quests is a free extension of Wanderer for World of Warcraft Forever. It shows every quest of your class, of every dungeon and raid and of every zone, each with the quests that lead to it, and where you stand with each. It is not an arrow over the world: it is a book you open to plan your way.

sections.h2: Which quests does Wanderer Quests show?
paragraphs: Three tabs: your class, its own quests by bands of levels; dungeons and raids, the quests of each and every quest that leads to them; zones, every zone with quests for you, the one you stand in chosen first.
Only what is for you: your race, your class, your side. Each place says its levels and how many of its quests you have done.

sections.h2: How do I see a quest chain?
paragraphs: A place's quests are drawn as a tree: the quests that open others above them, wherever they start, in the colors of their difficulty. The quest you need to open a dungeon chain, the class quest no one tells you about, the one you skipped three zones ago: they are all there.
Each says if it is done, in your log, to take, after another, another choice taken, or too high for now. A quest the game let you skip is said passed.

sections.h2: What does a quest's sheet show?
paragraphs: A click on a quest opens its sheet beside the window: what to do, in its own words, and its story; the items it asks with how many you already carry, the creatures or objects to find; who gives it and who takes it back, with a pin on your map for each.
Read ahead: a quest still far off is prepared as well as one in your log.

sections.h2: Does it work with the other Wanderer addons?
paragraphs: What a quest asks goes to Wanderer's reminders in one click, with how many you carry as you gather it. Its items go to the shopping list of Wanderer Auction, searched all at once at the auction house.

faq.q: Do I need Questie or another quest addon?
faq.a: No. Everything Wanderer Quests knows comes with it, from the CMaNGOS classic database and pfQuest. Only Wanderer is needed.

faq.q: Does Wanderer Quests slow down my game?
faq.a: No. Its data is read only when you first open the window, only your language is loaded, and where you stand is always asked of the game, never saved apart.

faq.q: Does Wanderer Quests draw arrows or markers over the world?
faq.a: No. It shows nothing over the world: a pin goes on your map only when you ask for one.

faq.q: How do I open Wanderer Quests?
faq.a: From Wanderer's minimap menu, its options page, or by typing /wquests.

faq.q: Does it know the quests added by WoW Forever?
faq.a: Not yet: it knows the quests of the original game. Tell us which new ones you meet in the comments on CurseForge.
Yes, completely, like Wanderer. It is free software under the GPL-3.0, translated into 10 languages.

section.h2: Can I keep a shopping list?
paragraphs: Yes. Items added from Wanderer Quests or from Wanderer's reminders gather in a shopping list, searched all at once on the buying page, cheapest first; what is not on sale is said. What you already carry enough of leaves it by itself. Identical items to sell stand on one line and are posted together, like a stack.

section.h2: Can I act on many items at once?
paragraphs: Yes. The Select button beside the search lets you choose one item or several (Shift+click for a run), then act on them all from a bar under the squares: keep them, set them aside for the auction house, mark them as junk, put them in a section of yours, sell them at a merchant or deposit them at the banker.
